steps.content: She treads alone in the dark wilderness, losing track of how long or how far she has gone. The mere act of advancing in the somber mire is exhausting all her strength.
Likewise, she can no longer clearly recall those restless ghosts hindering her in the darkness.

steps.speaker: Worshipper
steps.content: Go and confess that you've disrespected God with blasphemous thoughts, and now you'll atone for your sin in exchange for Stor Town's safety.
In a daze, the girl finds herself back in the town center. Below the circular <color=#fb9259>altar</color>, the townspeople's faces are twisted as they make desperate and cruel prayers.

The worshippers cry and shout, their faces filled with different emotions: fear, despair, anger... but not a shred of <color=#fb9259>reverence</color>. Countless filthy and horrifying hands reach out to Hestia, almost drowning her.

steps.speaker: Worshipper
steps.content: If you're a real <color=#fb9259>priestess</color>, sacrifice yourself to God. If you're a fake <color=#fb9259>priestess</color>, then give your life as atonement. Choose your fate.

steps.speaker: Worshipper
steps.content: You're just a blind <color=#fb9259>kid</color> who can't survive without us. You should fear us, please us, beg for our protection! Because we are the brave and strong <color=#fb9259>adults</color>!

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Don't touch me!
She swings her torch, and the fire rises instantly, dispersing the stubborn shadows around it.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: What kind of <color=#fb9259>adults</color> are you? You pathetic cowards who could only rely on a <color=#fb9259>kid</color> when disaster struck, why should I fear you? You're nothing to me!
The nightmarish shadows catch fire and turn to ash. Finally, she can catch her breath.
Time is running out. Hestia quickly steadies her breath, steps over the ash leaning against her torch, and presses onward. This is how she's come all this way.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I'm no longer afraid of you... I need to keep going... I'm going to find those who are most important to me...
Following her closely, barely audible whispers emerge from the darkness.

steps.speaker: Indistinct Whisper
steps.content: Those... who are most important to you?

steps.speaker: Indistinct Whisper
steps.content: Heh heh... Are you talking about... them?
[Scene change]
The ground suddenly collapses under her feet. Hestia slips and tumbles down, feeling a sharp pain in her ankle as she falls onto a pile of mess.

Several figures approach. This feels familiar... Yes, it was when she first got banished from Stor Town and left to die in the forbidden zone. There, she met the expedition at her last breath and was taken in by them.
Tears instantly fill her eyes. Hestia struggles to her feet, wanting to call their names, eager to tell them all about her terrifying journey to reach them. But the figures speak first.

steps.speaker: Ethereal Figure
steps.content: No one asked you to come <color=#fb9259>search for</color> us...
She hears the dark, eerie echo, so malicious it makes even her heart shiver.

steps.speaker: Ethereal Figure
steps.content: You're a liar. Nothing you say is true... You're always planning to escape and slow us down, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Ethereal Figure
steps.content: Say something! Admit all the lies you've told along the way, all the things you've done, how you've betrayed us selfishly and ungratefully!

steps.speaker: Ethereal Figure
steps.content: You're weak and useless. You've never been one of us, just a burden, a parasite. The expedition doesn't need you. Crawl back!

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ...I don't need you to tell me that.
She gasps for air as something heavy presses down on her. She stands with great effort, with the torch the only thing keeping her upright.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I know I'm not worthy of them. I will apologize... but not to you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They refused to leave you behind because of their principle. They let you go because they heeded your warning. They knew the path ahead was dangerous, so they wanted to keep you out of it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know, that's just the kind of people they are.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: They would never say such things. They are nothing like you. Of that, I'm sure!

Trembling, she lifts the torch, its fire rising to dispel the gloom on her. After letting it burn for a long while, Hestia wipes her tears. Time is running out. She continues on, using the torch to support herself.
Don't look back. You must not look back. Muster the courage. You must move forward.
She repeats this to herself over and over, relying on this nascent, fragile courage to keep going.
And above the darkness, in the sky she cannot see, the red Illusory Moon waxes, watching over the girl from high above.

steps.speaker: Indistinct Whisper
steps.content: Yes... Don't look back. You must not look back. Go and find the real them.

steps.speaker: Indistinct Whisper
steps.content: You will reach the <color=#dg1f1f>truth</color>...
[Scene change]
How long has it been? The ground under her feet is no longer muddy, but like a stretch of shallows. Hestia's mind is cloudy, but her vision is clear. She sees a red bloody path extending forward.
Under the red moon, in the crimson seawater, dozens of ashen, bloated bodies float in disarray, their faces frozen in the last moments before death.
Yet Hestia can hear their voices.

steps.speaker: Ghastly Figure
steps.content: You were right... That thing... No one should approach or see it... It's a path of no return...

steps.speaker: Ghastly Figure
steps.content: So everyone is dead now... This is the outcome you foresaw, <color=#dg1f1f>Guide</color>...

steps.speaker: Ghastly Figure
steps.content: Why did you come here? Do you want to... change something?
She doesn't have the strength to answer and simply continues walking.
Ahead stands a familiar figure bathed in red light.

steps.speaker: Little Guide
steps.content: You know it's fake, so why are you still so scared? You're even more skittish than before, Hestia.

steps.speaker: Little Guide
steps.content: Back then, all you needed to worry about was your own survival. What are you afraid of now? Your fear is so deep... It has bred this vast darkness.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ...I'm afraid they might die.

steps.speaker: Little Guide
steps.content: Heh heh... I'm afraid that can't be helped.
${PlayerName} laughs, a dark red viscous liquid welling up in those eyes, forming two streaks of bloody tears that stream over the unchanging smile.
Hestia sees it. Instinctively, she runs forward, dropping the torch to support ${PlayerName}, who immediately turns into a splash of red water, spattering all over Hestia.

steps.speaker: Little Guide
steps.content: You know you can't stop them. That's who they are. They'd risk it despite knowing the danger, like moths flying into a flame. You can't change them.

Hestia stands dazed, drenched in the crimson hue. She stays there for a long time before picking up the torch from the blood-red shallows. The torch has been extinguished, and darkness is creeping up the shadows.
Hestia leans on the torch, forcing herself to go on, each step harder than the last. Her eyes are hollow and her body shakes with each step, either from fear or from the cold.
But she never stops. She keeps going, and slowly, the dim sparks around her begin fluttering.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: They don't need to change...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I like them the way they are. I like watching them press forward, even if I can only watch from behind, I'm still pleased.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: The one who needs to change... is <color=#fb9259>me</color>...
The sparks are multiplying, gathering at the top of the torch, flickering constantly.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I've always lived in fear. I don't mind living that way even when I grow up. Everyone fears something.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: But <color=#fb9259>courage</color> is something you must reach past your fear to grip.

The flames burn brighter and brighter, illuminating the gnawing darkness, dispersing the silt covering her ankles. Hestia walks forward, over those familiar, fearful scenes, advancing despite shivering.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I've finally grasped my courage. There are many things I want to do. I... won't stop here!
In a place invisible to her, the illusion begins sinking back into the darkness. The path beneath her feet is turning smooth.
After a long silence, a distant, indistinct voice comes through the darkness.
...Good. Fear can no longer stop you. Come... I shall return your eyes...
The voice is so lofty. She can almost hear a disdainful sneer.
I invite you... to face the truth...
The darkness fades like a tide. The blood-red light obscures everything.
At the end of that red light, an indescribable, colossal being casts a nonchalant glance.
The red moonlight casts long shadows. Her shadow writhes and whispers to her.
Ancient memories begin to revive. This is the first <color=#fb9259>glimpse</color> of this world she has, which will reign over her deepest instinct ever since.
Gone is the past. The doom is near.
The searing stars shine, boiling and trembling.
Rising from the ocean depths, descending from the starry sky.
Omnipotent, omnipresent.
Rising it is, and rise it will, returning us to the blissful gloom.
Hestia opens her mouth but is unable to utter a word. She wants to step forward but her body is frozen. As if only now realizing her grave mistake, she questions why she's returned.
The frail human girl trembles, clutching the torch, but the flames in it are just like her brief and futile determination.
Extinguished easily.
You finally understand... Hestia...
For you... courage... is the poison...
